_comment: SEAM PART 2 — Terra Continental owns ALL landmass placement; Tectonic's own landmass generation is disabled. Tectonic normally fires its island system exactly where raw_continents is in [-1, -0.5) — which, once the seam feeds raw_continents from our radial field, is precisely OUR deep ocean. Every consumer blends as (island_selector * island_branch + continent_selector * continent_branch) with continent_selector = 1 - island_selector, so forcing this to 0 routes all four consumers (noise/full_continents, biome_parameter/erosion, biome_parameter/ridges, terrain_spline/offset/final) to the continent branch, which is keyed on raw_continents = our radial field. Tectonic still supplies all relief, erosion and ridge character on our continents; it just no longer decides WHERE land is. This also removes the scattered mushroom islands: raw_islands = (max(island_a,island_b) + 0.05) * spline(rc) - 0.7 drove continentalness as low as -1.365, punching through the -1.02 mushroom floor that continent_base maintains (vanilla mushroom band is below -1.05), so low island noise was producing mushroom_fields and high island noise was producing the small islands.
